title: Zephyr — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Zephyr.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Ventilation Reinvented." Premium tier. Zephyr has been the design-forward ventilation brand since 1997. While Broan-NuTone dominates on volume, Zephyr owns the premium and designer segment with sculptural hoods that double as kitchen art. Their Lux Connect WiFi system adjusts fan speed based on cooktop heat. The Monsoon and Tempest blowers are industry benchmarks.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Kitchen remodels where the hood is a design statement. Premium and luxury kitchen builds. Customers who want better than Broan.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Zephyr:

• Design-forward hoods that are kitchen art — not just functional boxes

• Lux Connect WiFi auto-adjusts fan speed based on cooking intensity

• Monsoon and Tempest blowers are industry-leading for airflow

• Statement hoods like the Horizon and Arc are conversation starters

• Only premium ventilation brand with dedicated designer showroom programs
